name: Tarkir
description: Tarkir is the home plane of Sarkhan Vol, Narset and Ugin, a plane of dragons and clans whose present belongs to dragonlords after Sarkhan changed history.

description_citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Narset". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

summary.text: Tarkir is the home plane of Sarkhan Vol, Narset and Ugin, a plane of dragons and clans whose present belongs to dragonlords after Sarkhan changed history.

citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Narset". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

bio.text: In its original timeline Tarkir is ravaged by clan wars and dragons are extinct, and Sarkhan returns there in disgrace, hearing a voice he believes is Ugin's.

citations.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.
"Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Sarkhan travels back more than a thousand years to the past, where dragons hatch from storms and five clans fight them as dragon slayers.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.
"A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

bio.text: Back in the present he finds a world ruled by dragonlords where Ugin and Narset are still alive, and the Tarkir of his birth is gone.

citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Sorin arrives searching for Ugin, who sleeps in a cocoon on Tarkir.

citations.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.
"Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

bio.text: Years later Ugin plans to lure Bolas to Tarkir, where the gate once stood at Ugin's grave.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

status.text: As of the latest events in the material, Tarkir is a plane ruled by dragonlords after Sarkhan's changed history, with Narset's devotion still tied to it.

citations.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Narset". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir in search of the spirit dragon Ugin, led by an oracle's visions toward a dragon-head mountain peak.
timeline.quote: Somewhere up there was his destination.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a warrior sentry and drains him dry to feed.
timeline.quote: drained him to a pale husk.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: A Temur band mistakes Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn and Sorin kills two warriors with death magic and raises them as vampire thralls.
timeline.quote: Sorin reached out his hand and willed the two leathery corpses back from the dead.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin turns Rushka against his captain, who beheads him, and a vampire thrall drains the captain.
timeline.quote: the captain reacted like a cat and struck the shaman's head off with one blow from his jawbone axe.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a surviving warrior to serve as his guide to Ugin.
timeline.quote: You shall serve me,

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
timeline.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol, mind unraveling, returns to Tarkir in disgrace and begins to hear a voice.
timeline.quote: I return in disgrace because no other plane will have me.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
timeline.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in a stalemated battle Sarkhan kills the Sultai sorcerer, finds a quiet point, hears an ancient voice and a fire dragon bursts from his soul, burning everything.
timeline.quote: From my soul, a being of pure fire burst into the sky.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
timeline.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to seek the whisperers of the mountaintops again to find the door and make Tarkir strong again.
timeline.quote: I will make us strong again.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset recalls growing up an outsider who retreated into imaginary worlds, then undertaking the Way of the Wandering Warrior and being appointed khan by the elders.
timeline.quote: my counsel was sought out by many regarding these matters, until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The imprisoned orcs all tell the same story, but the elders accept that they are lying; Narset concludes Tarkir is sick with war.
timeline.quote: Tarkir was sick with war.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset meditates atop a mountain peak, stops seeking an answer, and begins to dream of the worlds from her youth.
timeline.quote: The worlds from my youth rush toward me.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu hordechief feasts on the loot and has his advisors plan the next raid while privately hiding his own self-doubt.
timeline.quote: The shepherds will be moving their flocks north to the villages for winter.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A goblin spy tells the hordechief that an Abzan patrol half their size is tailing them and has seen the shepherd camp.
timeline.quote: An Abzan patrol is tailing us, only half a day's ride to the south.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief orders an immediate attack on the Abzan patrol and cuts off the tip of the quartermaster's finger when she questions him.
timeline.quote: who quickly snatched it, drew his knife, and sliced the tip off the pinky finger before she could react.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief hides his doubts about the gamble, believing he cannot show weakness if he wants to remain hordechief.
timeline.quote: To change course would be a sign of uncertainty.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
timeline.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A goblin protests that Zurgo's broken rock was taken at the cost of his sister's life, and Zurgo stomps him to death to protect his authority.
timeline.quote: Zurgo raised his left foot as high as he could, then stomped on the goblin, dropping all his weight onto it.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
timeline.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo declares Vol must die, and Varuk warns he is too dangerous, recalling Vol's desertion and dragonfire against the Mardu army.
timeline.quote: I was there when he turned into a great flying beast of flame and roasted your army with his breath.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo plans to hide his real aim by marching the horde into the mountains to punish Surrak, despite his wing leaders' objections.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow, we move into the mountains," he said to them. "We will punish Surrak for his impudence.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Unnatural snow falls as the Mardu enter the mountain valley, and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back.
timeline.quote: My khan, we must turn back. This is absurd. We are riding into a trap.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
timeline.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo gives three young warriors new names for their first kills: Headtaker, Heartpiercer, and Neckwringer.
timeline.quote: Headtaker," Zurgo decreed.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for leadership of the clan.
timeline.quote: I challenge you for the right to lead this clan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo defeats Batar in single combat and kills him, stomping his head.
timeline.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest, threw the limp form to the ground, and stomped his great foot on the man's head.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Varuk declares that Zurgo's horde fears him rather than serves him, and the horde follows Varuk home to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: They once served you. Now they only fear you. And that means that you are not truly their khan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Zurgo resolves to kill Vol, refusing to wipe Batar's blood from his blade until it mixes with Vol's.
timeline.quote: He would not clean it until it had mixed with Vol's.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills a dying Temur woman after learning Vol went toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb, then rides there alone.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the woman's throat and she stopped moving.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo's riding-beast breaks a leg, and he leaves it to die and continues on alone.
timeline.quote: Zurgo left it to die and continued alone.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees antlered dragons on Tarkir and realizes that the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, as Narset's scrolls foretold.
timeline.quote: And it had led him to the past. It had led him here.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
timeline.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan embraces the new beginning, calling it his Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This was a new beginning, a new Tarkir—his Tarkir.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: The guide describes Tarkir's past, where dragons hatch from storms and the five clans fight for survival as dragon slayers.
timeline.quote: Here, in the past, the five clans of Tarkir still exist.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea leading him across time, and that his choice will reforge Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: they were a plea from Ugin that had led Sarkhan across time to this place and this moment.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Daghatar receives Yasova's letter about Reyhan's death and orders word sent to the dragonlord to crush the holdouts.
timeline.quote: Tell the dragonlord that if we move now, we can either force the remaining holdouts to surrender…or crush them for good.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Jagun, and Doshiyn encounter Kolaghan, who lets them pass without attack.
timeline.quote: The dragon's mouth closed. Alesha lowered her bow.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha throws down the Mardu khan's banner and decides that she and the Mardu will follow Kolaghan rather than kneel.
timeline.quote: We don't have to kneel," said Alesha, grinning. "Just try to keep up."

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
timeline.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees a herd of dragons overhead and understands that the dragons survived, then transforms and joins them.
timeline.quote: And in his dragon form, Sarkhan Vol took to the sky.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The herd roars with Sarkhan, and he sees changed land with five broods and new dragons from a tempest.
timeline.quote: As he shot back up into the herd, he was greeted by nothing less than the sight of a dragon tempest rupturing before him.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan lands at the Mardu camp and is attacked by the goblin Vial Smasher, whom he knew as Ankle Shanker and who doesn't recognize him.
timeline.quote: You're here! You're alive! Just like the dragon.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms to shield Vial Smasher from her own thrown vial of dragonfire.
timeline.quote: As it shattered on the ground, Sarkhan transformed into a dragon and dove in front of Vial Smasher

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Zurgo, now the bell-striker, who does not know Sarkhan and says no one says the word khan under Kolaghan Dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan Dragonlord kill khan-sayers.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo mocks the name Vol and raises his dull blade; Sarkhan flees into the sky, realizing no one knows him in this changed Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Both orc and goblin stood in paralyzed stillness as Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Narset might be alive in this timeline and heads to Jeskai territory to find her.
timeline.quote: She would be here. She would be alive!

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Eight-year-old Narset, restless in a crowded marketplace, accidentally topples a stack of apples and is told to wait outside.
timeline.quote: She lifted her arm, holding the apple on display—as hundreds more rained down around her

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Free outside, Narset runs along the river and hears Ojutai's lesson across the distance, and asks to be his student; he nods.
timeline.quote: I want to be your student," she said. "Please, let me be your student."

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: For three years Narset trains under Ojutai from afar by the riverbank.
timeline.quote: Over the next three years, Narset studied, trained, and practiced under the Great Teacher from afar.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Dragonspeaker Ishai invites Narset to study at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: To study under the Great Teacher.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset searches archives under Cori Mountain and Riverwheel and learns of Ugin and the dragon tempests.
timeline.quote: She learned of a Spirit Dragon, Ugin, who was the source of all magic on the plane, as well as the dragon tempests.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Years later, by the river bend, Ojutai asks Narset what she has learned, and she tells him she has learned the truth.
timeline.quote: I have learned the truth," she whispered.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset thanks Ojutai and lets go, walking away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Her words were carried away on the winds of Tarkir as she let go.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, once the Mardu khan of another timeline, serves as Kolaghan's bell-striker, rousing warriors with his greatsword when she stirs to battle.
timeline.quote: Zurgo has been reduced to serving as an attendant to the dragonlord Kolaghan.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's law outlaws ancestor magic as necromancy, and a few renegade spirit speakers hide kin-trees.
timeline.quote: Ancestor magic, once practiced by the distant forebears of the modern-day Dromoka humanoids, is outlawed by the dragonlord as a form of necromancy.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for kin-tree worship, but a ghostly figure like her is seen fighting alongside the Dromoka.
timeline.quote: However, she practiced ancient kin-tree worship, and for that she was executed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir, uneasy beneath the sun, searching for Ugin who may be dead and guided only by an oracle's vague visions.
timeline.quote: His only guide now was a cluster of vague impressions given to him by an oracle.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: A party of Atarka warriors mistakes Sorin for a Silumgar death-spawn and threatens to take his head.
timeline.quote: Your head will decorate a spear tonight.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin enthralls a warrior as a guide and learns from him that the khans fell, the dragons now rule, and Ugin dwells in the Haven.
timeline.quote: Ugin is the beating heart of the world. He dwells within the Haven.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds this timeline's Narset walking through the snow; she doesn't know him but has read secret histories about the sar-khan.
timeline.quote: About a dragon-man, a sar-khan, who came from something called the Unwritten

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan arrives on Tarkir, recalls his past and the ghost of Ugin urges him to find the doorway; he sets out for the mountains.
timeline.quote: who urges him to "find the doorway."

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin fights through Temur hunters, makes a vampire guide and finds Ugin dead in the canyon, concluding the Multiverse is doomed.
timeline.quote: Ugin is long since dead, and Sorin concludes that the Multiverse is doomed.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, mad with rage after his Mardu refuse to follow his personal quest, kills the challenger and leaves alone to hunt Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo's command is challenged, and he kills the challenger

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in Tarkir's past, sees Atarka and Yasova, and realizes he has traveled back in time.
timeline.quote: He realizes the truth: he has traveled into Tarkir's past

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur seeks out the dragon Silumgar and offers his allegiance for the dragon's help.
timeline.quote: his allegiance for the dragon's assistance.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Daghatar destroys the Remembrance and pledges his clan to Dromoka's service.
timeline.quote: Daghatar destroys the Remembrance

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
timeline.quote: He encounters the dragonlord Kolaghan

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin awake, learns he was never born in this timeline, and finds Narset, a Planeswalker exile; both are content to remain on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: both Planeswalkers agree that they are exactly where they wish to be.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Vial Smasher spends a lifetime handling and smashing vials of dragonfire in the Kolaghan clan.
timeline.quote: she has spent a lifetime handling—and smashing—vials of this dangerous substance

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.
timeline.quote: Ikra Shidiqi, his naga advisor, betrayed him to the dragonlord Silumgar.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to the dragon Dromoka, rallies the Abzan as their final khan, and dies in the khanfall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ishai gains autonomy and authority as Ojutai's attendant.
timeline.quote: Ishai's word carries the full authority of Ojutai

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he will lure Bolas to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas appears before Ugin on Tarkir, having followed Azor's clues.
timeline.quote: when his nemesis appeared before him

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Azor's statues as the reason he was found.
timeline.quote: Your idiot cat is too fond of statues of himself,

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas overpowers Ugin with a swarm of dragon eyes and attackers.
timeline.quote: The Spirit Dragon tried to escape, but was caught in a tempest of fire and claws.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A man out of time preserves Ugin's body in a cocoon of stone.
timeline.quote: That man preserved Ugin's body in a cocoon of stone and vanished.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away, believing he has won.
timeline.quote: And Nicol Bolas planeswalked away, never to return, for he had won.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin is torn into the space between planes and then lands on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: being torn from the only place I had never known and flung into the space between the planes.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin hovers above still waters between planes, realizing he has walked between worlds, then arrives on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This must be one of the planes of which Te Ju Ki speaks.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
timeline.quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: On a cliff overlooking the steppes of Tarkir, a man in blue and a woman stand while a sleeping, restless creature is held in his arms.
timeline.quote: A creature is asleep in his arms.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset remembers her years as Ojutai's favored student and admits that in saving Tarkir she lost her dragon.
timeline.quote: In saving Tarkir, Narset lost her dragon.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska urges Jace to stop using Loot's mind, saying Loot keeps trying to hide from him.
timeline.quote: He keeps trying to hide from you.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Jace admits he reaches into Loot's mind, Vraska compares it to what he did to Chandra, and they argue over whether the cost is worth it.
timeline.quote: You hurt her, Jace. You hurt her badly.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Vraska begs Jace to let the dead rest, and Jace refuses, insisting he must fix everything.
timeline.quote: I know what I have to do.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 6: How Wretched Love" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, bound to the dragons by the ritual, resolves to destroy the temple that rivals his control.
timeline.quote: And the first thing he needed to do was destroy the temple.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin arrives and the wild dragons flee.
timeline.quote: The wild dragons simply fled, shrieking their terror

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin burns Sarkhan with ghostfire and Sarkhan dives away through the storm.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas, I am afraid, is free.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset's planeswalker spark ignites, giving her the ability to walk the Blind Eternities, though her devotion stays with Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Now that Narset's Planeswalker spark has ignited, she has the ability to walk the Blind Eternities, the space between planes, and discover new worlds

citation.text: "Narset". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Narset carefully and painstakingly continues her research into the mysterious past, which might hold long-lost magic.
timeline.quote: So she carefully and painstakingly continues her research.

citation.text: "Narset". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After a victory against a rival clan, a long-dead dragon's spirit whispers a spell into Sarkhan's mind and vanishes.
timeline.quote: The spirit of a long-dead dragon appeared to him, whispered a spell into his mind, and then vanished forever.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A huge fire dragon bursts from Sarkhan's body and burns his men and his enemies to cinders, igniting his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: a huge dragon made of fire streaked out of Sarkhan's body and invaded the battle

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Disillusioned by Bolas, Sarkhan falls into madness and is led back to Tarkir by a voice he believes is Ugin's.
timeline.quote: Disillusioned by his servitude to the villainous, conniving, woefully undragonlike Bolas, Sarkhan fell into madness.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aided by Narset at the cost of her life, Sarkhan travels back through time to prevent Ugin's death at Bolas's hands.
timeline.quote: a way to travel back through time to the moment of Ugin's death at Nicol Bolas's hands and prevent the spirit dragon from falling.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pulled back to the present, Sarkhan finds a world ruled by dragonlords where Ugin and Narset are still alive.
timeline.quote: a world in which both Ugin and Narset were still alive.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Tarkir of Sarkhan's birth is gone, and Sarkhan is now a man never born, with his mind free of Bolas and Ugin.
timeline.quote: his mind is once again his own, free of the influences of both Bolas and Ugin.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time more than a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, ensuring the dragon tempests and thus dragons continue.
timeline.quote: he travelled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death.

citation.text: "Tarkir". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With dragons secured, their numbers grow and the tide of the war turns.
timeline.quote: With the dragons' presence secured, draconic numbers grew and soon, the tide of the war turned.

citation.text: "Tarkir". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The dragons hunt down and destroy the khans and claim the vacant thrones.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, the dragons were able to hunt down the khans and destroy them.

citation.text: "Tarkir". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The defeated clans come to be ruled by five legendary dragonlords and battle for control of Tarkir on their behalf.
timeline.quote: In this present, the defeated clans are ruled by five legendary dragonlords.

citation.text: "Tarkir". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
